rationale: The prospectively fixed breakout-plus-range-expansion law generated 11919 events across 246477 eligible windows, with at least one event on 37 of 40 structural representatives. This is sufficient to evaluate one fixed short-horizon directional follow-through diagnostic on the same development bytes without selecting symbols, varying parameters or opening economics.

prospective_followthrough_law.anchor_price: close of the breakout-expansion event bar t
prospective_followthrough_law.future_contiguity: t,t+1,t+2,t+3 must all be exactly 300 seconds apart
prospective_followthrough_law.overlap_policy: events may overlap; no independence or significance claim is made

required_outputs: per-symbol continuation/reversal/flat counts split by event direction
coverage loss from non-contiguous future bars
prohibitions: no return magnitude or normalized return
no PnL, costs, entry/exit execution assumption or position sizing
no symbol ranking, selection or promotion
no inferential rejection or significance testing
no economic identity or V2 attempt
